title: SkillCatalog
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

name.description: The last segment of the skill's folder.

description.description: The description of its front matter; null without one.

repository.description: The URL of the other Git repository, as the entry `git+<url>#<ref>:<path>` names it.

commit.description: The commit of the other repository that factory.lock pins; none while factory.lock has no pin.

items.description: The variable of a secret in a sandbox (ADR 0068), like "LINEAR_TOKEN".
A host as an entry of `sandbox.egress`, like "api.linear.app".

needs.description: What it needs, from the `metadata` of its front matter.

unevaluatedProperties.description: A reference to a secret, resolved at the egress proxy, never in the sandbox: "ref:<provider>/<name>".

secrets.description: The agent's reference whose variable is each secret the skill needs, by the variable.

items.description: The variable of a secret in a sandbox (ADR 0068), like "LINEAR_TOKEN".
A host as an entry of `sandbox.egress`, like "api.linear.app".

lacks.description: Each needed secret the agent does not declare, and each needed host its sandbox does not allow.

items.description: An agent that uses a skill.

agents.description: Each agent that uses it, sorted by name.

files.description: The files of its folder, by their path below it, sorted.

body.description:
The text of SKILL.md below the line that ends its front matter, all of it without front matter; null without a
SKILL.md that is UTF-8 text.

problems.description:
The problems of its own files as `factory lint` prints them, relative to the folder of factory.yaml, and a folder
without a SKILL.md.

items.description: One skill, also one that lint refuses: then `problems` names why.

description:
What `factory skills` of factory-spec prints (ADR 0141, ADR 0143): every skill the factory's agents use, read with
the rules of `factory lint` (ADR 0140), sorted by name. The console reads it for its pages `/skills` and
`/skills/<name>`, so it never parses a SKILL.md itself.
